scenario: A coworker invites you to join an impromptu hiking trail that splits off the main path into a unmarked forest section after work.
Your local library announces a week-long event dedicated to poetry from obscure 17th-century regions that are no longer widely practised.
A friend suggests taking a flight to a city you have never heard of, where the airport terminal is only accessible via a small boat.
You notice a campaign in your building lobby recruiting citizens to participate in an immersive street theatre piece about the local political changes of the last decade.
A noon potluck meeting distributes a plate of boiled octopus with vinegar, which is an unfamiliar taste and texture for most attendees.
A colleague proposes a weekend trip to a small village where no commercial modern hotels exist and smartphone reception is very weak.
Your team at work holds a meeting in an unusual open-air meeting room under a large transparent glass dome in the middle of the park.
A local theatre company announces a play in which the performers do not speak but communicate entirely through facial expressions and rhythmic body gestures.
You discover a broken-down car at the edge of a main road, and the passenger invites you and your friend to rest in their rare olive garden.
A university centre offers an evening class on crafting your own type of fermented vegetable taro food without guidance.
A museum exhibits an overwhelming performance piece where the audience must change clothes to enter each new room.
During your coffee break, a local group of drummers begins improvising in the courtyard without previous rehearsal.
A fellow employee suggests exploring a deep river canyon on a rented kayak that requires practicing spatial rotation.
You find a flyer for a hybrid show mixing silent film viewing with live juggling routines in a darkened room.
A colleague you work with mentions they are considering opening a tiny national flag display window-less shop in an alley.
A bus driver stops at a scenic overlook to let passengers adjust the panoramic window and see a valley.
A local community centre organizes a festival where participants must collect traditional recipes using a specialist map.
You receive an invitation to a dinner where guests must arrange the seating themselves based on a personality trait.
A friend takes you to a market where sellers offer spices from minuscule remote islands, some of which they discover on their phone.
A tour guide in a trendy district uses a device to show virtual platforms floating above the street.
A workshop room in a university science building offers a practice session on building a small water rocket and shooting it.
You pass by a doorway on the street where a giant golden statue of an previous emperor covers the wall.
A local poetry circle is quietly reciting a set of traditional rhymes at a park bench near a lake.
During a presentation, a colleague projects an informational graphic of an ancient wilderness culture onto a wall.
A city council meeting begins a two-hour debate in a crowded school gymnasium regarding new citizen permits.
A young visitor in the museum takes out a tape recorder to record the whispered history document in the gallery.
A travel guide requests that you write down three highly unusual personal facts on a visible badge.
A local bank offers a loan option structured with interest calculated only on seasonal reset points.
A balcony at your apartment building hosts a continuous fading purple sound projection through the afternoon.
A science exhibition room has a trade fair exhibit only opened in the dark, making it look like a classical theatre.
A ferry to a small island leaves each hour, and the pedestrian exit opens onto a wooden walkway.
A peer office in a tech building presents a software product that keeps memory visible at all times.
A doctor explains that you should walk through a moving solar flare period that hits the roof.
A classical row of paintings in an exhibition hall asks the audience to stand on multiple rotating wooden disks.
A neighborhood team builds a giant kite together using bamboo sticks and a huge sky blue canvas sheet.
A public sign tells visitors to look up, revealing a rare metal swan sculpture hanging from the ceiling.
A town square displays a tailor-made photographic mural of real people needing to be encouraged forward.
A car ride at sunrise through a long empty desert road leads up to an undefended coastal cliff.
A government departure hall has a separate queue exclusively for young applicants completing a two-year engineering degree.
A plant diary asks you to photograph the top three most-colored sunflowers you encountered in a meadow.
A popular movie theaters show two identical non-financial interest stocks moving up in the audience.
A veterinarian explains that the blood work only requires nondemonstrable light filters over one of the eyes.
A local spa offers a seasonal relaxation routine using extensive historical phonetic scrolls laid over the body.
A scientific survey requires you to stand perfectly weightless while technical processing rotates a handle.
A high school board uses a single complete draw-by-board vote instead of using a printed ballot.
A resident claims that an unmarked white cabin at the end of a circular driveway emits complex ambient sound.
A dining spot on a floating boat offers a composite dining hub with no consistent physical table.
A historical mountain observatory offers a glass tube so visitors can view unfiltered star patterns face on.
A roadside vending machine only dispenses regional binary chart pieces printed on a very thin plastic card.
A tourism office asks visitors to submit a short text based on music heard during their last international train ride.
